other_text: *Note on classification hierarchy:*

Classification labels (e.g. "Poor", "Sufficient", "Good") are *dynamic,* they are defined and named by the Governance Authority as part of the active Metadata Quality Profile (MQP) and are not hardcoded in the system (see functional description: "The Governance Authority can define a metadata quality classification to label the level of quality", and technical description: "The Advanced Search UI dynamically retrieves fields from the Metadata Quality Profile to provide Consumers with intuitive quality filters").

The ordering used to evaluate "equal to or better than" is derived from the *score ranges* assigned to each classification in the active MQP. A classification is considered *better* than another if its associated score range has a strictly higher lower bound. For example, if the active MQP defines:
- "Sufficient": 40–70 %
then selecting "Sufficient" as the minimum returns resource descriptions classified as "Sufficient" or "Good", because those classifications correspond to score ranges with a lower bound ≥ 40 %.

* authenticate the calling Trusted Governance Authority using the established mutual TLS mechanism and verify that its federation is still enabled when the details request is handled; this authenticates the Governance Authority, while the mapped Consumer attributes are used for discovery-policy evaluation;

# Technical description
The existing xfsc-advsearch-be resource-detail API must allow a Consumer to retrieve the full contents of a resource description returned by a federated search.
For a federated resource, the API must:
* accept the resource identifier returned by the federated search;
* request the details through the local Trusted Governance Authority flow;
* preserve the existing resource-detail representation, return all published properties, and carry the applicable schema returned by the federated flow;
* return defined not-found, forbidden, timeout, and downstream-error responses; and
* keep the own-catalogue lookup behavior unchanged.

The participant-facing API change is an extension of the existing resource-detail capability, not a new standalone API. The Governance Authority forwarding, identity mapping, policy evaluation, Trustor catalogue lookup, and Schema Manager lookup are implemented by [SIMPL-31150](https://jira.simplprogramme.eu/browse/SIMPL-31150) and [SIMPL-31153](https://jira.simplprogramme.eu/browse/SIMPL-31153).
# Technical design
* Extend the existing xfsc-advsearch-be GET /selfDescriptions/{id} flow to support federated resource identifiers.
* Invoke the local Trusted Governance Authority flow for federated resources and retain the direct own-catalogue path.
* Return the complete resource-description representation to the Consumer through the API, with the applicable schema propagated by the federated response path.
* Preserve the existing API contract for own-catalogue resources.
* Add API tests for successful federated retrieval, not-found, forbidden, timeout, and downstream-error cases.

bp_requirements.title: Create a new resource description
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ selects the resource type (data, application, or infrastructure) and enters required and optional common metadata.

bp_requirements.title: Add resource type specific metadata
bp_requirements.text: Depending on the selected resource type, the _Provider_ adds the resource type specific required and optional metadata.

bp_requirements.title: Add policy and contract related metadata
bp_requirements.text: For access and usage control, the _Provider_ configures the policies that shall be applied to the new resource. The _Provider_ also adds required and optional metadata related to the usage contract for the specific resource.

bp_requirements.title: Sign and submit the resource description
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ signs the new resource description with the _Provider_'s credentials and submits it to the _Governance Authority_.

bp_requirements.title: Validate the resource description
bp_requirements.text: When receiving a request to publish a new resource description (or a new version), the _Governance Authority_ performs syntactic validation, semantic validation against schema and vocabulary, and quality-rules validation.

bp_requirements.title: Remediate validation issues
bp_requirements.text: In case of validation issues, the _Governance Authority_ informs the _Provider_. The _Provider_ must remediate and resubmit the resource description for publication.

bp_requirements.title: Publish the resource description
bp_requirements.text: Upon successful validation, the new (or new version of the) resource description is published in the data space catalogue.

bp_requirements.title: Create a new version of a resource description
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ selects a previously published resource description and initiates the creation of a new version, updating required and optional metadata.

bp_requirements.title: Update resource type specific metadata
bp_requirements.text: Resource-type-specific metadata can be updated for a new version of a resource description.

bp_requirements.title: Update policies and contract related metadata
bp_requirements.text: Policies and contract-related metadata can be updated for a new version of a resource description. After this step, creation of a new version continues with signing and submission, identical to the new-resource flow.

bp_requirements.title: Revoke the previous version of the resource description
bp_requirements.text: If the new version of the resource description is valid, the _Governance Authority_ revokes the current (previous) resource description version.

bp_requirements.title: Inform about new version
bp_requirements.text: If a resource description is updated, the _Consumers_ of this resource are informed about the new version in the data space catalogue.

bp_requirements.title: Request resource description revocation
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ selects a previously published resource description and initiates the revocation of this resource description.

bp_requirements.title: Revoke a resource description
bp_requirements.text: Upon receiving a request for revocation, the _Governance Authority_ revokes the resource description from the data space catalogue.

bp_requirements.title: Inform about revocation
bp_requirements.text: If a resource description is revoked, the _Consumers_ of this resource are informed about the revocation.

bp_requirements.title: Search in data space catalogues
bp_requirements.text: The _Consumer_ initiates a search using either a quick search or an advanced search, and selects the applicable search scope: the own data space catalogue, federated catalogues of other data spaces, or the DOME Marketplace catalogue. The _Consumer_ inputs the search terms relevant to the intended search and optionally a filter related to metadata quality classification. That filter applies to data space resources only, as DOME does not provide a corresponding quality profile for its offerings.

bp_requirements.title: Add access policy filter parameters to the query
bp_requirements.text: The query is enriched to filter on resource descriptions whose discovery access policies permit their discovery by the _Consumer_ (and potentially the specific End-User of the _Consumer_ from the own data space). The filtering applies to the data space's own catalogue.

bp_requirements.title: Execute query
bp_requirements.text: The _Governance Authority_ finds resource descriptions matching the provided search terms within the data space's own catalogues.

bp_requirements.title: Conduct a quality rating of the resources
bp_requirements.text: The _Consumer_ accesses the resource descriptions returned for the search: - if the _Consumer_ has chosen to search only the own catalogues of a data space, the _Governance Authority_ provides resource descriptions only from its own catalogues. The results include the metadata quality of the resource; - if the _Consumer_ has chosen to search only one or more federated catalogues of other data spaces, the _Governance Authority_ provides resource descriptions only from the selected federated catalogue or catalogues; - if the _Consumer_ has chosen to search both own and federated catalogues, the

bp_requirements.title: Search one or more federated catalogues of a trustor data space
bp_requirements.text: The Trusted _Governance Authority_ identifies the Trustor _Governance Authorities_ of the selected federated catalogues, enriches the search request with the _Consumer_'s identity attribute parameters and forwards the search request to each Trustor _Governance Authority_. > **Source-site note:** until the 30 September 2026 revision this step was titled "Access the filtered search results and select one or more resources", left over from the previous version and not matching its text. The title now matches.

bp_requirements.title: Handle a search from a trusted data space
bp_requirements.text: The Trustor _Governance Authority_ receives a search request from a Trusted _Governance Authority_ and maps the _Consumer_'s identity attributes received from the Trusted _Governance Authority_ against the agreed federated attribute mapping. The federated search mechanism follows a single-hop federation model. A Trustor _Governance Authority_ therefore does not forward the received search request to another Governance Authority or Trusted Governance Authority.

bp_requirements.title: Add access policy filter using the mapped attributes
bp_requirements.text: The query is enriched to filter on resource descriptions whose discovery access policies permit their discovery by the _Consumer_ (and potentially the specific End-User of the _Consumer_) of the trusted data space, hence considering the mapped identity attributes.

bp_requirements.title: Execute query for a Consumer of a trusted data space
bp_requirements.text: The Trustor _Governance Authority_ finds resource descriptions matching the provided search terms within the catalogues of the data space for a _Consumer_ of a trusted data space.

bp_requirements.title: Forward search results to a trusted data space
bp_requirements.text: The Trustor _Governance Authority_ provides the filtered search results to the Trusted _Governance Authority_ that had forwarded the query.

bp_requirements.title: Receive search results from a trustor data space
bp_requirements.text: The Trusted _Governance Authority_ receives the results for a forwarded search request from a Trustor _Governance Authority_.

bp_requirements.title: Collect and provide resources
bp_requirements.text: The _Governance Authority_ collects the filtered resource descriptions from its own catalogues and from the federated catalogues across other data spaces. These resource descriptions are provided together to the _Consumer_ that initiated the search. Where the _Consumer_ has selected the DOME search scope, the _Governance Authority_ also collects the offerings retrieved from the DOME Marketplace in step BP06.12 and aggregates them with these resource descriptions.

bp_requirements.title: Forward query to DOME Marketplace catalogue
bp_requirements.text: Where the _Consumer_ has selected the DOME search scope in step BP06.01, the _Governance Authority_ forwards the query to the DOME Marketplace catalogue and receives the offerings that match the search criteria. Both quick and advanced search are supported. A DOME Marketplace search is not filtered by access policies: all data space Participants can access DOME offerings once the _Governance Authority_ has enabled the DOME search scope through BP02G.

bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall allow a Consumer to search resource descriptions in the catalogues of a data space via UI and API by: ; Selecting the catalogue for the search; ; Choosing the search method: quick or advanced; ; Providing one ore more search terms; ; Selecting the expected level of metadata quality of the search results: minimum metadata quality classification (e.g. only show resources with medium metadata quality classification or higher). The quick search method maps the provided search terms to any of the properties of the resource description. (SIMPL-469)

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer searches in the catalogues of a federated data space
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall allow a Consumer to search resource descriptions in the catalogues of a federated data space via UI and API by: ; Selecting one or several federated catalogues for the search; ; Searching in all federated catalogues without explicitely selecting them; ; Choosing the search method: quick or advanced; ; Providing one ore more search terms (SIMPL-25100)

bp_requirements.title: The Governance Authority provides resource descriptions matching a search request
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support the Governance Authority to automatically provide resource descriptions that: ; Belong to the selected catalogue of the search in the data space; ; Match the chosen search method (quick or advanced); ; Match the submitted search terms; ; Matching the selected metadata quality level; and ; Comply to the discovery access policies enforced by Simpl-Open. (SIMPL-23882)

bp_requirements.title: A Governance Authority maps the identity attributes for a search received from a Trusted Governance Authority
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support a Governance Authority receiving a search of a Trusted Governance Authority, along with the relevant attributes of the Consumer, to map these identity attributes based on the mapping defined during federation. (SIMPL-28867)

bp_requirements.title: A Governance Authority provides resource descriptions matching a search request received from a Trusted Governance Authority
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support a Governance Authority, receiving a search request from a Trusted Governance Authority, to automatically provide resource descriptions that: ; Belong to the catalogue of its data space provided in the search; ; Match the chosen search method (quick or advanced); ; Match the submitted search terms; and ; Comply to the discovery access policies taking into account the mapped identity attributes. (SIMPL-28868)

bp_requirements.title: A Trustor Governance Authority provides resource descriptions matching a forwarded search request to a Trusted Governance Authority
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support a Trustor Governance Authority to automatically provide resource descriptions to a Trusted Governance Authority in reply to a forwarded search request. The search results are returned to the requesting Trusted Governance Authority (not to the Consumer). (SIMPL-25101)

bp_requirements.title: A Trusted Governance Authority forwards a search request to a Trustor Governance Authority
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support a Trusted Governance Authority to handle search requests from consumers involving one or more federated catalogues by ; Identifying for each of the selected federated catalogues, the relevant Trustor Governance Authority ; Forwarding the search request with the relevant catalogues to the identified Trustor Governance Authority on behalf of its Consumer ; providing the identity attributes of the Consumer together with the request. (SIMPL-27800)

bp_requirements.title: A Governance Authority provides resources descriptions matching a search request to a Consumer
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support the Governance Authority to provide a Consumer the collected resource descriptions from own and federated catalogues across data spaces, matching the Consumer's search request. (SIMPL-28870)

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer consults the overview of resource descriptions returned from own catalogues by a search request
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall allow a Consumer to consult via UI and API, a list of resource descriptions from its own data space's catalogues that was returned by a search request. This list includes for each resource description: ; Main properties of the matching resource descriptions; ; Overall metadata quality score and quality classification. This list can be sorted based on the main properties and quality properties. (SIMPL-4497)

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer consults the overview of resource descriptions returned by a search request from a federated catalogue
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall allow a Consumer to consult via UI and API, a list of resource descriptions from a federated catalogue of a data space that was returned by a search request. This list includes for each resource description: ; Main properties of the matching resource descriptions. This list can be sorted based on the main properties. For a federated search, sorting may not apply to quality properties, as the definition of data quality can deviate between different data spaces. (SIMPL-27804)

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer consults the details of a resource description returned from an own catalogue by a search request
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall allow a Consumer to consult via UI and API, the details of a resource description from its own data space's catalogue that was returned by a search request. This includes following information about the selected resource description: ; All published properties of the resource description; ; The overall metadata quality score and quality classification; ; The metadata quality score and quality classification for each dimension. (SIMPL-23885)

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer consults the details of a resource description returned by a search request from a federated catalogue
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall allow a Consumer to consult the details of a resource description returned by a search request via UI and AP from a federated catalogue, which includes following information about the selected resource description: ; All published properties of the resource description. (SIMPL-27805)

bp_requirements.title: A Trusted Governance Authority forwards a request for the details of a resource description to a Trustor Governance Authority
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support a Trusted Governance Authority to handle requests for the details of a resource description from Consumers involving a federated catalogue by ; Identifying the federated catalogue and the relevant Trustor Governance Authority of the resource description ; Forwarding the request to the identified Trustor Governance Authority on behalf of its Consumer ; providing the identity attributes of the Consumer together with the request. (SIMPL-27806)

bp_requirements.title: A Governance Authority maps the identity attributes for a resource description request received from a Trusted Governance Authority
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support a Governance Authority receiving a request for details of a resource description from Trusted Governance Authority. Furthermore, Simpl-Open shall support the Governance Authority to map the identity attributes based on the identity attribute mapping defined during the federation configuration, that it receives along with the request. This will ensure correct authorisation and policy enforcement in the trustor data space. (SIMPL-27807)

bp_requirements.title: A Governance Authority provides the details of a resource description to a Trusted Governance Authority
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support a Governance Authority to automatically provide the details of a resource description from an own catalogue to a Trusted Governance Authority in reply to a forwarded request. The details of the resource description is returned to the requesting Trusted Governance Authority (not to the Consumer). (SIMPL-28871)

bp_requirements.title: A Governance Authority provides the details of a resource description from a federated catalogue
bp_requirements.text: : Simpl-Open shall support a Governance Authority to receive the details of a requested resource description from a Trustor Governance Authority and provide them to the Consumer that requested the resource description. (SIMPL-28872)
